inherited_baseline_series_member.note: This inherited-baseline game is not added to the supplemental ledger; it is used only to close the 10-game College of Idaho all-time series accounting.

completeness_basis: College of Idaho's official all-time-opponent table reports 0-10 vs Gonzaga, first year 1926 and last year 1961.
College of Idaho's official historical season-result pages expose nine pre-1958-59 Gonzaga rows.
Gonzaga's inherited schedule section contains the tenth series game on 1960-12-02, a 95-61 Gonzaga win.
Gonzaga's 1958-59 and 1959-60 inherited schedules contain no College of Idaho game.
Therefore the nine supplemental rows plus the inherited 1960-61 game account for the entire 10-game series.

date_residuals.note: Source provides only the season label as date.
The source embeds the row in the 1953-54 table immediately before 01/30/54. The exact calendar year is not silently corrected; canonical game_date remains blank.
